comment: The onset of a high-speed solar wind stream from a northern coronal hole is expected during the first interval. ACTIVE with a chance of STORM G1 conditions are anticipated. The coronal hole influence could persist into the 2nd period. There have been two Coronal Mass Ejections (CME) observed leaving the Sun during the past 24 hours: one following a filament lift off on 13-AUG from the SE quadrant and a second associated with C4.1 X-ray flare at approximately 06:40 UT on 14-AUG. Based on limited imagery and data about these events we estimate their arrival during the latter half of the 3rd interval. ACTIVE up-to STORM G2 periods possible on impact.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
